name: Clari
description: Clari, now part of Salesloft, is a revenue orchestration platform for enterprise sales and RevOps teams, providing AI-driven forecasting, pipeline inspection, and deal-risk signals, alongside sales engagement (Groove) and conversation intelligence (Copilot) modules.
best_for: Enterprise revenue and sales-operations teams that want AI-driven forecasting and pipeline visibility connected to sales engagement and conversation data in one platform.
features: AI-driven forecasting and pipeline inspection (Clari Forecast and Inspect)
Automated activity capture into the CRM (Capture) to reduce manual data entry
Sales engagement and cadences via the Groove module
Conversation intelligence and call coaching via the Copilot module
Buyer collaboration and mutual action plans (Align)
Revenue Database (RevDB) unifying CRM, email, calendar, and call data into one revenue graph
AI "Action Hub" recommendations (Guide) and autonomous Revenue AI agents for deal inspection
pros: Combines forecasting, pipeline inspection, sales engagement (Groove), and conversation intelligence (Copilot) in one connected platform rather than separate point tools
Holds ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and SOC 2 Type II certifications and states GDPR compliance on its security page
States a large operating scale (revenue managed and number of customer organizations) reflecting enterprise-grade deployment
cons: No published self-serve pricing; the pricing page contains no plan names or numbers and leads only to a contact form
Positioned and priced for large/enterprise revenue teams rather than small sales teams
Salesloft is now the company and platform brand, while Clari Forecast retains its name; buyers should verify current module packaging and integration with the vendor.

faq.question: Does Clari publish its pricing?
faq.answer: No. Clari's pricing page has no plan names or numeric prices; it is entirely a request-a-quote page, so pricing requires contacting sales.

faq.question: Are Clari and Salesloft the same company?
faq.answer: Yes. An official announcement published December 3, 2025 confirms that Clari and Salesloft completed their merger. Salesloft announced on September 2, 2026 that it is the company and platform brand going forward, while Clari Forecast retains its name. Confirm current module packaging and integration with the vendor.

faq.question: What is Clari Copilot?
faq.answer: Copilot is Clari's conversation-intelligence and coaching module, part of its broader revenue orchestration platform.

alternatives.name: Gong
alternatives.description: A revenue intelligence platform that records and analyzes sales calls, emails, and meetings to surface deal risk and inform forecasting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams whose primary need is conversation-level deal intelligence and coaching rather than a full sales-engagement/cadence layer.

alternatives.name: Outreach
alternatives.description: A sales engagement platform for building multichannel outreach sequences with conversation intelligence and AI-driven forecasting.
alternatives.best_for: Teams that want a dedicated sales-engagement platform for sequence execution rather than a forecasting-first suite.
